summary.name: The Clipboard Project (CB)
summary.one_liner: CB is a free, open-source terminal clipboard manager that lets you copy text, files, and folders to a clipboard from the command line and paste them later.
use_cases: copy text or files from the terminal
summary.what_it_does: The page describes CB as a lightweight clipboard manager that runs from the command line using the cb command. Users can copy words, files, and folders, for example with "cb copy" followed by file names. It supports creating multiple separate clipboards, manipulating their contents with regular expressions, and scripting operations. Installation is done through convenience scripts for non-Windows (curl | sh) and Windows (PowerShell), with other install options linked. Help is available through a wiki, GitHub discussions, and a Discord group.
notable: Copies files and folders as well as text from the command line
Multiple independent clipboards manipulable with regex
Open source code hosted on GitHub
Listed in awesome-mac under Clipboard Tools
caveats: Terminal/command-line interface rather than a graphical app
Page does not specify exact supported platforms beyond Windows and non-Windows installs
